tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README introduces oxiguitar-wasapi as the WASAPI audio output plugin for OxiGuitar, a guitar tablature viewer. It explains that the plugin plays OxiGuitar's sound through WASAPI (Windows' built-in sound system), is Windows-only, and shares its core audio code with other OxiGuitar audio plugins via the oxiguitar-audio-cpal crate.

tour.title: Plugin Manifest
tour.description: manifest.json declares the plugin's identity: id oxiguitar.audio-wasapi, interface version 1.3, Windows-only conditions, and the audio-device service named 'wasapi' with priority 10. This file is what OxiGuitar's plugin host reads to discover and register the plugin.

tour.title: Build Configuration
tour.description: Cargo.toml defines the Rust crate oxiguitar-audio-wasapi-plugin with its Windows-only cpal dependency and OxiGuitar SDK pulled by git tag. clippy.toml enforces MSRV 1.99, deny.toml enforces GPL-3.0-compatible licenses, and rustfmt.toml sets formatting rules. Together these ensure reproducible, compliant builds.
tour.languageLesson: Rust crates use Cargo.toml for package metadata, dependencies, and profile settings. The [profile.release] section here enables thin LTO, single codegen unit, and symbol stripping for minimal binary size.

tour.title: Core Plugin Implementation
tour.description: src/lib.rs is the entire plugin logic: the Audio struct implements Plugin::start to create a CpalDevice using cpal's WASAPI host, Service::probe to report availability (Unavailable outside Windows), and Service::call to forward audio operations to the underlying device. The export_plugin! macro registers it with OxiGuitar's plugin system.
tour.languageLesson: Rust conditional compilation with #[cfg(target_os = "windows")] allows the crate to compile on all platforms while only providing real functionality on Windows. Non-Windows builds return Availability::Unavailable and Unsupported errors.

tour.title: Contract Testing
tour.description: tests/contract.rs builds the crate as an .oxp file and validates it through OxiGuitar's own plugin host, ensuring the built plugin matches its manifest contract. This is the project's only test and runs under the Windows target only, since the plugin is Windows-specific.

tour.title: Build and Compliance Scripts
tour.description: build-oxp.sh compiles the plugin as a cdylib with the oxp feature and produces a versioned .oxp file for Windows. scripts/check-dco.sh verifies that every commit in a PR range carries a DCO sign-off, with exemptions for automated bot commits from Claude and Dependabot.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipelines
tour.description: Three GitHub Actions workflows form the project's automation: ci.yml runs formatting, linting, multi-platform tests (6 OS targets), license checks, and DCO verification on every PR and push. release.yml builds the plugin for all Windows architectures. publish.yml notifies package repositories when a release is published.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows use on triggers (pull_request, push, workflow_dispatch) to activate. The ci.yml workflow uses a ci-success gatekeeper job that checks all other jobs passed, enforcing branch protection rules.
